teaser.en: Yellow flowers, then black fruits sitting on a bright red cushion like beads on a button.
teaser.sw: Maua ya manjano, kisha matunda meusi yaliyokaa juu ya mto mwekundu angavu kama shanga juu ya kifungo.
teaser.dg: Maruwa ga rangi ya mandano, na badaye matunda maru ganagokala dzulu ya nyama-nyama ya kundu inayong'ala, dza ushanga dzulu ya chifungo.

summary.en: Mtsometsome is Ochna mossambicensis, a shrub or small tree of coastal bush and forest. Pakia records only its Digo name.
summary.sw: Mtsometsome ni Ochna mossambicensis, kichaka au mti mdogo wa vichaka na misitu ya pwani. Pakia anarekodi jina lake la Kidigo tu.
summary.dg: *Mtsometsome* ni *Ochna mossambicensis*, chitsaka au muhi mdide wa weruni na matsaka ga pwani. Pakia anaandika dzinare ra Chidigo tu.

about.en: Mtsometsome is a shrub or small tree with glossy, finely toothed leaves. Like other Ochnas, it has bright yellow flowers that fall quickly, after which the sepals turn red and enlarge. The fruits are shiny black, one-seeded segments set on a fleshy red base, a striking combination that makes Ochnas easy to spot. The Digo recognise it by its leaves.
about.sw: Mtsometsome ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani yanayong'aa na meno madogo. Kama Ochna nyingine, una maua ya manjano angavu yanayopukutika haraka, na baadaye sepali hugeuka nyekundu na kuongezeka ukubwa. Matunda ni vipande vyeusi vinavyong'aa, kila kimoja na mbegu moja, vilivyokaa juu ya kitako chekundu chenye nyama; mchanganyiko huu wa kuvutia hufanya Ochna kuwa rahisi kuzitambua. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Mtsometsome* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ganang'ala, genye meno madide sana kanda-kanda. Dza *Ochna* zanjina, una maruwa ga rangi ya mandano inayong'ala ganagogbwa upesi, na badaye makodza madide ga photsi ya ruwa (*sepals*) ganagaluka ga kundu na ganakula. Matunda ni maru ganang'ala; chila seemu ina tembe mwenga, na seemu zosi zinakala dzulu ya nyama-nyama ya kundu. Rangi hizi mbiri phamwenga ni za ajabu, na zinahenda *Ochna* zikale rahisi kumanyikana. Adigo anaumanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, thicket and forest edges from Kenya to Mozambique.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka, vichaka-mwitu vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani kuanzia Kenya hadi Msumbiji.
where.dg: Unamera weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani, kula Kenya hadi Mozambique.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsometsome but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Ochna mossambicensis, after Mozambique.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsometsome lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina yanayoshirikiwa na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Ochna mossambicensis, kwa jina la Msumbiji.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtsometsome*, ela kalavya mana ya dzina hiri wala madzina ganagohumirwa ni luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Ochna mossambicensis*, kula dzina ra Mozambique.
